notes: Setup durations: submodule 45s, npm ci 8s, reference:build 243s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 75s, baseline unit 98s.

Matching native negotiation for inputs that native converts to gbrap/yuva444p/yuvj444p would need new entries in the shared negotiation table packages/avfilter/src/video-ops/formats.ts; not made (shared edit outside scope).
Registry examples start from format=yuva420p or use 0:0:0:0 so they stay inside native-equivalent negotiation on the 8x8 gray source.
Option values are limited to one decimal digit; native AV_OPT_TYPE_INT also evaluates expressions.
